images.subject: Far away on the horizon, on top of a towering sea cliff, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: Beyond the ridge, towering dark neutral grey rock cliffs heavily covered with thick white snow and ice plunge straight into a vast frozen sea of cracked pale ice with ice floes and pressure ridges, which stretches to the horizon, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are the dark sea and plain dark rocky shore sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, on top of a towering sea cliff, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: Beyond the ridge, towering scorched dark basalt cliffs with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks plunge straight into a vast dark slate-grey sea with heavy swell and thick white steam rising from its surface, which stretches to the horizon, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising far in the distance.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are the dark sea and plain dark rocky shore sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, at the foot of a huge flat-topped mesa, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: The vast plain is blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, dotted with tall flat-topped mesas and slender buttes of layered grey rock heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, stretching to distant snow-covered mountains, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are plain bare dark rocky plain sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, at the foot of a huge flat-topped mesa, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: The vast plain is made of baked deep muted oxblood-red earth, dotted with tall flat-topped mesas and slender buttes of scorched dark basalt with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks, stretching to distant mountains, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are plain bare dark rocky plain sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, in a clearing at the foot of a towering cliff, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: The valley is covered by a frozen alien jungle of giant strange plants with huge broad leaves and twisted trunks, all heavily coated in thick white frost, snow and icicles, rising in layers toward distant snow-covered mountains, on a frozen alien planet of ice and wind-blown snow.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are the dark canopy of the jungle sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.
